- The restructuring of the `process` method to delegate to `updateHostsFromZooKeeper()` improves code readability and separates concerns, while the new `setInitialTraceHosts()` method encapsulates the retry logic in a scheduled task, ensuring that the initialization of tracing can be retried if it fails initially.
- Overall, these changes work together to ensure that the tracing client can recover from transient failures when connecting to ZooKeeper, thereby improving the reliability of the tracing system.
